title: DLS: Dual-Logic Graph Neural Networks with Chaos-Fuzzy Residuals for Robust Link Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.22607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Link prediction is a fundamental task in graph mining, critical for applications ranging from biological interaction discovery to recommender systems. While Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art results, they are fundamentally limited by the inadvertent suppression of high-frequency signals, as the recursive aggregation that stabilizes structural learning inherently leads to over-smoothing, rendering node representations indistinguishable in deep layers. This limitation is particularly severe in heterophilous graphs, where structural proximity does not imply feature similarity. In this paper, we propose DLS (Dual-Logic SAGE), a novel inductive framework designed to break the over-smoothing barrier via a "controlled instability" mechanism. translated_title: DLS：基于混沌-模糊残差的双逻辑图神经网络，用于鲁棒链接预测
translated_abstract: 链接预测是图挖掘中的一项基础任务，对于从生物相互作用发现到推荐系统等一系列应用至关重要。尽管消息传递神经网络（MPNN）已取得了最先进的成果，但其从根本上受限于高频信号的无意抑制，因为用于稳定结构学习的递归聚合本质上会导致过平滑，使节点表示在深层网络中变得难以区分。这一限制在异配图中尤为严重，因为在异配图中，结构上的邻近并不意味着特征上的相似。在本文中，我们提出了DLS（双逻辑SAGE），这是一种新颖的归纳式框架，旨在通过“受控不稳定性”机制打破过平滑壁垒。与依赖静态结构启发式的传统方法不同，DLS引入了动态残差流水线。首先，混沌注入模块利用Logistic映射……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了DLS归纳式图神经网络框架，通过混沌注入与动态残差构成的“受控不稳定性”机制突破消息传递神经网络的过平滑瓶颈，从而在异配图等挑战性场景下实现更鲁棒的链接预测。
en_tdlr: DLS is an inductive graph neural network framework that breaks the over-smoothing barrier in link prediction through a "controlled instability" mechanism combining chaotic injection and dynamic residuals, delivering robust performance especially on heterophilous graphs.
